metadata.name: Wikipedia to Amazon Book Search
metadata.description: Navigate to Wikipedia page for Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, then search for the book on Amazon India and click the first result

actions.description: Click on the search input field
Type 'hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy wikipedia' into the search box
actions.input_text: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy wikipedia
actions.expected_outcome: Search query appears in the search box

actions.description: Click the Google Search button to submit the search
Click on the Wikipedia result for Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
actions.expected_outcome: Wikipedia page for the book loads

actions.description: Scroll down to view more content on the Wikipedia page
Click on the search bar in Amazon
Type 'hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy' into the Amazon search box
actions.expected_outcome: Search query appears in the search box with autocomplete suggestions

actions.description: Click the search button or press Enter to search
actions.expected_outcome: Amazon search results page loads with book listings

actions.description: Scroll to view more search results
Click on the first book result in the search results
actions.expected_outcome: Product detail page for the book loads

expected_final_state: User is viewing the product detail page for Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy on Amazon India
